text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Ben Ali discusses with Interior Minister Rejeb and commander of National Guard Mustapha Badreddine action to reinforce security and stability.
- Visiting Argentine Senate Speaker Eduardo Menem says next visit of President Ben Ali to Argentina will be important event.
- Agriculture Minister Bahri says cereals areas sowed this season total one million hectares (2.5 million acres).
- Agriculture Minister Bahri says olive oil output this season put at 250,000 tonnes, citrus production estimated at 211,000 tonnes.
- Consumer's Defense Association to hold congress on Saturday.
- Three Pizza Hut restaurants closed in Tunis and suburbs for health reasons.
